root_cause: Default cluster-migration-barrier=1 allows an existing replica to migrate to the new orphaned primary during Operator scale-out. The Operator also adds two new replicas there; a source primary falls to one replica. During rollback the extra original replica is forgotten as part of the removed shard, so its running Pod still has a live replication link but other peers know only 8 of the expected 9 members.
